name: Dokploy
line: Open-source deploy panel for your own servers, with a paid Cloud option.

free.text: Core is free to self-host; Cloud from $4.50/month/server

work.math: $0 for the software, plus a capped server charge: 730 hours at $0.03571 an hour, never more than $24. $0 for extra data transfer.
$0 for the software + a $24 capped VM + $0 for extra data transfer. The app and the controller share the same VM.
$0 for the software + $24 for the VM + $7.20 for a daily whole-disk image backup (0.30 times the $24 VM price) + $0 for traffic. It is not a Postgres dump.
